description: The **Power BI Ultimate KPI Card Custom Visual** helps report authors turn important business measures into clear, action-oriented KPI cards. It displays a main KPI value together with the variance to a reference value, such as a budget, target, plan, forecast, or previous-year result. It can also compare the main value against a second or third reference value. Variances can be shown as absolute values and percentages, supported by arrows, color coding, and status indicators so users can quickly see whether performance is above, below, or on target. This offer is designed for **Power BI report authors, BI developers, analysts, controllers, dashboard designers, and business users** who need to present KPI performance in a compact and easy-to-understand format. It is especially useful for executive dashboards, mobile reports, operational scorecards, financial reports, sales reports, and reporting portal landing pages. The visual addresses a common reporting challenge: business users often need to understand current performance, target achievement, variance, and trend direction at a glance. Standard tables or charts can make this harder to see quickly. The Ultimate KPI Card combines KPI value, target comparison, variance analysis, visual status cues, and optional trend information in one card, helping users identify performance gaps and focus on metrics that require action.…
